description: Na₄Zr₂(GeO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.68 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.46 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.18 Å) Zr-O bond lengths. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.17 Å) Zr-O bond lengths. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-43°. There is one shorter (1.76 Å) and three longer (1.77 Å) Ge-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃ZrGe trigonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Zr, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃ZrGe trigonal bipyramids.
